data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to seek to provide current income, commensurate with relatively low risk while providing a high level of liquidity, primarily through a portfolio of Tri-Party REPO), Repo in Government Securities, Reverse Repos and similar other overnight instruments. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: 1. Tri-Party REPOs, Repo in Government Securities, Reverse Repos and any other similar overnight instruments as may be provided by RBI and approved by SEBI: 95% - 100% 2. Other Money Market Instruments with residual maturity of upto 91 days: 0% - 5%
data.fund_managers: Mr. Anil Ghelani, Mr. Diipesh Shah
